what: adjudication_beta, lognormal_product and ceiling_confidence accept inputs that give a plausible wrong number.
how: Verified. adjudication_beta refuses n_regimes < 1 and negative n_parameters/precision; lognormal_product refuses |rho| > 1, a pair listed in both orders, and a negative variance (< -1e-9) instead of max(var,0); ceiling_confidence refuses negative/NaN n_scored. All raise RigorIntegrityError (a ValueError). Live callers pass valid values (drill/verify_math rows unchanged).

what: _save can erase a fresher in-memory verdict for a host that was already dirty (found live, read DEAD for 24 h).
how: Verified by interleaving. _DIRTY is now cleared only for hosts whose _MEM entry is still the object that was saved; a host re-probed mid-save stays dirty and its fresher verdict is not folded back over.

what: Non-relativistic p^2/2m is used where p exceeds mc: a Planck-confined proton reports 3.18e27 J and a false 'exceeds Planck energy' objection.
